lavernock.title: Lavernock Jurassic magnetic susceptibility

params.selection: Report the strongest local spectral peak within 0.74–0.88 m and its own multiple-testing threshold. If no peak is detected, report all three as null. Use the native observations and describe the tested frequency family.

output_fields.wavelength_m: Wavelength at selected peak or null.
output_fields.peak_power: Power at that same peak, nonnegative or null.
output_fields.fdr05_power: 5% FDR power threshold on the same scale at that bin, or null if unavailable.

lavernock.interpretation: The published feature requires both its position and simultaneous evidence above 5% FDR; a pointwise threshold does not answer this question.

petm-published.title: Howards Tract PETM — published protocol interval

output_fields.global_p: Full rate-search adjusted p value or null.

petm-published.interpretation: Independent modern COCO comparison using the MS protocol recovered from Supplementary Text 3, pages 22–23: raw 187.54–211.24 m interval, original 20 m LOESS, linear 0.01 m interpolation, Pearson, NFFT 5000, frequency 0–0.06 cycles/kyr, six periods and 2000 draws. Modern phase-averaged target/null still differ from historical Acycle 2.4.1; not an exact old-engine replay. The original broader-interval failed comparison is preserved.

petm-broad.title: Howards Tract PETM — broader sensitivity interval

output_fields.global_p: Full rate-search adjusted p value or null.

petm-broad.interpretation: Broader-interval modern COCO comparison on untuned MS below the Nanjemoy basal unconformity. Uses published six targets, 20 m LOESS, rate grid and 2000 draws, but extends below the actual published interval and uses median 0.005 m interpolation, Spearman and default NFFT/frequency settings. The original 8–15 cm/kyr comparison remains unchanged; see separate published-protocol case. No exact historical-paper reproduction.

odp926b-timeopt.title: ODP 926B — precession amplitude modulation

params.historical_protocol: 0.1 m interpolation; remove variability below 0.06 cycles/m using LOWESS; precession band 0.035–0.065 cycles/ka, roll-off 1000.

odp926b-timeopt.interpretation: Distance to the 2015 TimeOpt optimum in Fig. 5. ASM and the individual objective components yield other optima.

la-thure-coco.title: La Thure — whole-section sedimentation rate

params.historical_protocol: Log susceptibility; interpolate at 0.3 m; 80 m robust LOESS; 2000 MC draws.

la-thure-coco.interpretation: 8 cm/ka is the approximate broad maximum. The 6.6–10.4 range is the reported p<0.01 region of the original COCO scan, not an uncertainty interval on the true rate.

anticosti-precession.title: Anticosti LL1 — precession template
anticosti-precession.interpretation: Supplement Figs. S5–S6. Compare like templates separately. The NACP isotope series is a different core.

anticosti-eccentricity.title: Anticosti LL1 — eccentricity template
anticosti-eccentricity.interpretation: Supplement Figs. S5–S6. Compare like templates separately. The NACP isotope series is a different core.

bridge-meyers.title: Bridge Creek C/T boundary — meyers dates

output_fields.ctb_age_ma: CTB age (Ma), posterior median if available.
output_fields.ci95_ma: Optional [lower,upper] in Ma, or null for a point estimate.

bridge-meyers.interpretation: Reference is the published model median and 95% interval for this date set. Grayscale and bentonites use the author position coordinate. No independent age truth is implied.

bridge-updated.title: Bridge Creek C/T boundary — updated dates

output_fields.ctb_age_ma: CTB age (Ma), posterior median if available.
output_fields.ci95_ma: Optional [lower,upper] in Ma, or null for a point estimate.

bridge-updated.interpretation: Reference is the published model median and 95% interval for this date set. Grayscale and bentonites use the author position coordinate. No independent age truth is implied.

cenogrid-modulation.title: CENOGRID — dominant isotope periods in four fixed bands

params.inputs: residuals after archived LOWESS and PETM treatment; search power within each specified band.

output_fields.carbon_1_myr: Dominant period in this predeclared frequency band (Myr).
output_fields.carbon_2_myr: Dominant period in this predeclared frequency band (Myr).
output_fields.oxygen_1_myr: Dominant period in this predeclared frequency band (Myr).
output_fields.oxygen_2_myr: Dominant period in this predeclared frequency band (Myr).

cenogrid-modulation.interpretation: Compare with the v2.8 manuscript-reproduction fields. Peak displacement is descriptive; a matching period alone makes no phase or detection claim.

lr04-gaps.title: LR04 — recover withheld isotope observations

params.mask: fixed singletons and contiguous gaps, all at native ages
params.input: data.csv gives retained observations; queries.csv lists withheld ages and gap class.

output_fields.prediction.csv: age_ka,benthic_d18O_permil, at all requested ages in order.

lr04-gaps.interpretation: Scores against actual withheld isotope measurements on the published tuned axis. Report RMSE and bias separately for isolated observations and contiguous gaps.

synthetic-rate-step.title: Synthetic two-rate depth section

params.output_support: estimate one characteristic rate for each marked interval in windows.csv
params.sampling: The proxy is observed every 0.05 m throughout both intervals.

synthetic-rate-step.interpretation: Known design values test scale and ability to resolve the rate change.

synthetic-detection.title: Periodic signals versus matched AR(1) records

params.input: Long-form data.csv, record_id,sample,proxy. Submit one full-search detection per record, in ID order.

synthetic-detection.interpretation: Report positives detected and null false alarms separately. Forty public realizations provide a small calibration panel, not a blind leaderboard.

cip1-case3.title: CIP 1 Case 3 — elapsed time from a virtual depth series

params.origin: 0 ka at 0 m; elapsed time increases upsection. Source CSV header says cm; the generator defines metres.
params.task: Estimate an elapsed-time curve at all observation heights; the supplied proxy is the observable.

output_fields.prediction.csv: segment,coordinate_m,time_ka at each query, in supplied order; time increases along the coordinate within every segment.

cip1-case3.interpretation: Public retrospective reconstruction of the CIP generator at observation heights. Preserve end error and deviations within the competing cycle-count interval.

meishan-tuning.title: Meishan — short-eccentricity tuning on the Li section

params.constraints: Use published terminal relative times (anchors.csv), and the two observed logs. Report ages on the Li relative-time axis, increasing upsection.

output_fields.prediction.csv: segment,coordinate_m,time_ka at each query, in supplied order; time increases along the coordinate within every segment.

meishan-tuning.interpretation: Compare with the 288 published Excel pairs. Interior times are a tuned solution; equality is evidence of historical agreement. The original depth-domain passbands and full author tie-point list remain unresolved.

odp846-oracle-original.title: ODP 846-calibrated synthetic section — original variability

params.protocol: Conditional interpolation between perfect obliquity ties, segment endpoints and both sides of two prescribed gaps; seed 117. queries.csv is a 0.05 m depth grid with segment endpoints in preserved sediment.

output_fields.prediction.csv: segment,coordinate_m,time_ka at each query, in supplied order; time increases along the coordinate within every segment.

odp846-oracle-original.source: ODP846 / LR04 calibrated open obliquity-oracle experiment, seed 117
odp846-oracle-original.interpretation: Piecewise-linear interpolation is a comparator. This is a synthetic age model calibrated from ODP 846; error here is not the accuracy of the ODP 846 chronology.

odp846-oracle-reduced.title: ODP 846-calibrated synthetic section — reduced variability

params.protocol: Conditional interpolation between perfect obliquity ties, segment endpoints and both sides of two prescribed gaps; seed 117. queries.csv is a 0.05 m depth grid with segment endpoints in preserved sediment.

laurin-stable.title: Laurin-style conditional tuning — stable

params.input: Noisy replicate 0 of the full-trend synthetic experiment. Fixed cycle assignment and depth windows; infer the three adjacent durations.

output_fields.interval_1_ka: Elapsed duration between adjacent query depths (ka).
output_fields.interval_2_ka: Elapsed duration between adjacent query depths (ka).
output_fields.interval_3_ka: Elapsed duration between adjacent query depths (ka).

laurin-stable.source: Laurin-style synthetic comparison inspired by https://doi.org/10.1029/2020PA004188
laurin-stable.interpretation: Synthetic full-trend control; weak-band and variable-rate variants use the original frozen injections. These three cases are individual realizations. The three duration errors do not establish coverage across the 300-record experiment.

output_fields.interval_2_ka: Elapsed duration between adjacent query depths (ka).

hays76-simplex.title: Hays, Imbrie & Shackleton (1976) — two-core SIMPLEX frequency test

params.protocol: Use the two separate linear age models in Table 2. Estimate three periods for each channel; Table 3 uses unprewhitened spectra. The later archive includes repeated depths. Report how they were combined.
params.grid_convention: [first age ka, spacing ka, number of points]. Historical lag truncations are 40 and 50.
params.question: Report the three band maxima for each core; the scorer also compares the within-core ratio of obliquity to precession periods to the published ratio test.

output_fields.rc11_long_ka: Estimated long peak period (ka) on the rc11 SIMPLEX chronology.
output_fields.rc11_obliquity_ka: Estimated obliquity peak period (ka) on the rc11 SIMPLEX chronology.
output_fields.rc11_precession_ka: Estimated precession peak period (ka) on the rc11 SIMPLEX chronology.
output_fields.e49_long_ka: Estimated long peak period (ka) on the e49 SIMPLEX chronology.
output_fields.e49_obliquity_ka: Estimated obliquity peak period (ka) on the e49 SIMPLEX chronology.
output_fields.e49_precession_ka: Estimated precession peak period (ka) on the e49 SIMPLEX chronology.

metrics.comparison: Hays et al. (1976), Table 3, reported band b/c ratio
Hays et al. (1976), Table 3, reported band b/c ratio

hays76-simplex.interpretation: Table 3 values are individual core and proxy estimates. RC11-120 summer SST and E49-18 planktonic oxygen isotopes have different best periods. The 1976 SIMPLEX chronology is held fixed.

rossello-precession.title: Lourens et al. (1996) — Rossello Mediterranean cycle correlation

params.section: Capo Rossello composite; unstarred Table 1 levels at heights 40–128 m. Height decreases as age increases.
params.question: Assign ages to all listed sedimentary cycle levels using the two endpoint ages and orbital pacing. Allow unexpressed cycles. Candidate data omit published ages, cycle codes and insolation-cycle numbers.
params.orbital_input: Alternative La2004 65°N summer insolation in W/m². Published chronology uses La90(1,1); record the orbital solution and response lag used.
params.lag_convention: Table 1 horizon ages lag the corresponding insolation maxima by 3 kyr in forward time, i.e. subtract 3 kyr from peak ages in ka BP.

output_fields.prediction.csv: Return segment,coordinate_m,time_ka in query order. The optional ensemble uses the same coordinates.

rossello-precession.interpretation: Absolute age deviations from the published Table 1 correlation on retained horizons. The older section with the duplicated 37.860 m entry lies outside this interval. The fixed endpoints are part of the question.

odp846-published-clock.title: Shackleton, Hall & Pate (1995) — eastern Pacific Site 846 benthic isotope tuning

params.section: 63.43–96.00 m revised composite depth (rmcd). Use the isotope records, two terminal ages and optional La2004 65°N summer insolation.
params.question: Recover an increasing age-depth model in ka BP. Coordinates are ordered by revised composite depth. Carbon measurements have three missing values in this selection; oxygen measurements are complete.

output_fields.prediction.csv: Return segment,coordinate_m,time_ka in query order. The optional ensemble uses the same coordinates.

odp846-published-clock.interpretation: Empirical Table 5 chronology. Printed Table 5 and Table 7 establish the oxygen/carbon interpretation; the PANGAEA Table 5 text headers reverse it. The supplied modern forcing is optional. The historical age model also drew on the Leg 138 regional chronology.

newark-long-eccentricity.title: Olsen & Kent (1999) — Newark long eccentricity modulation

params.section: Nursery through Martinsville, Lockatong–Passaic composite tuned depth ranks.
params.question: Estimate the wavelength of the McLaughlin carrier and the long modulation in the same archive coordinate. Convert their ratio to ka using the stated 404 ka calibration and report the long period. The file begins at a nonzero tuned depth.

output_fields.modulation_ka: Long period of depth ranks in ka on the 404 ka scale.

newark-long-eccentricity.interpretation: The circa 1.75 Myr article-level interpretation is a comparison target conditional on an already tuned scale. The ratio calculation cancels the units of the archive coordinate.

xiamaling-precession.title: Xiamaling Cu/Al at 1.4 Ga — joint rate and axial precession

params.question: Jointly estimate accumulation rate and the axial precession frequency. Document the orbital model, any frequency priors and the conversion of k to sidereal day length.

output_fields.rate_cm_per_ka: Mean accumulation rate in cm/ka; give the posterior mean if available.
output_fields.precession_arcsec_yr: Axial precession frequency k (arcsec/year); give the posterior mean if available.
output_fields.lod_h: Derived sidereal length of day in hours, or null.
output_fields.rate_ci95: Optional 95% interval [low,high] in cm/ka or null.
output_fields.precession_ci95: Optional 95% interval [low,high] in arcsec/year or null.
